title: Noodles
logline: Monday. Clearance instant noodles, the serious pages on the wall, the message board's silence. The chorus at the back with their backs turned. The eviction notice is Wednesday; the strip is already hungry.

panels.composition: The garage at night, the CRT's glow. WOOD eating noodles from the pot. On the wall: eight pages of a serious graphic novel — a timber faller, a ridge, cross-hatched. BARNABY. At the back: six STICK FIGURES, backs turned.
props: eight serious pages on the wall

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man eating instant noodles from a pot in a dark garage lit by a CRT monitor, eight dense cross-hatched graphic-novel pages pinned on the wall, a small dog, six crude stick figures at the back with their backs turned
image.notes: The chorus faces away from the serious pages. Their backs are the review.

panels.composition: The monitor: the message board. The serious page posted. Views: 41. Comments: 0.

balloons.text: Forty-one people looked at a man carrying a saw up a ridge and none of them had anything to say.
That's a review, Barnaby. That's a very complete review.

panels.composition: The noodle pot, empty. The clearance sticker on the packet: 3 FOR $1. The dog licking the pot. The stick figures still turned away.
